additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397393-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / N5 160345957] Charger stops while charging CRM:01811000542
additional_info.body:
Hello
Joseph,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have analyzed the logs for today, and it appears that the vehicle was successfully connected. However, the authentication process failed, which caused the charging session to fail. Additionally, it seems that you attempted to charge the vehicle without unplugging it, which is why the charging is currently failing.
To resolve this, please follow these steps:
Unplug the vehicle.
Wait for 2 minutes.
Reconnect the vehicle and try charging again.
This should allow the charging process to start properly.
If you continue to experience issues or have any further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.
Thank you for your understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
